result.summary: Found several visual issues: a loading spinner stuck over content, truncated restaurant names, and an incomplete category chip row that looks cut off.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is permanently overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, obscuring the dish photo and looking like a stuck or broken load state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image has loaded, or only show it during actual loading; ensure the image load completes and the overlay is removed.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, cutting off the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, shrink font slightly, or use text-overflow: ellipsis so truncation is intentional and readable.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ends with a partially visible empty/white chip on the far right, which looks like a broken or unfinished UI element rather than a normal scroll peek.
issues.suggestion: Ensure only real category chips are rendered, or style the trailing peek so it clearly belongs to the next chip (e.g. show partial label) instead of a blank pill.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the fastest restaurants uses a very light gray that may be hard to read on white, especially for '€0.90 delivery' and similar lines.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of secondary meta text (darker gray) to meet readability guidelines.
